ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the M2-3,
Light Industry District symbols and indications as shown on Map No.6-J in the area
bound by:

      The Atchison, Topeka, and Santa Fe Railway; South Kedzie Avenue; a line 204.42 feet
      north of and parallel to West 31st Street; and a line 265.75 feet west of and parallel to
      South Kedzie Avenue,

to those of a B1-3, Neighborhood Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          ____________________________
                                                          Michael Rodriguez
                                                          Alderman, 22nd Ward




Common Address:
3010-3030 S. Kedzie Avenue
